## Alexis Araujo
**Agricultural Engineer & Geospatial Data Specialist**

## Professional Journey

I am a results-driven **Agricultural Engineer and Geospatial Data Specialist** with over a decade of hands-on experience driving spatial analysis, network modeling, and data automation across industrial, forestry, and agricultural sectors. My career is defined by a commitment to bridging the gap between field operations and cutting-edge geospatial technology—transforming complex datasets into production-grade pipelines, strategic geographic insights, and resilient logistical frameworks[cite: 1].

With a foundational background in Agronomy and Crop Science, my expertise has evolved into advanced Python-driven automation and multi-platform GIS solutions (QGIS & ArcGIS Pro), allowing me to streamline workflows and solve critical infrastructure bottlenecks at scale[cite: 1].

*   **Geospatial Software & Cloud Systems:** QGIS (Professional Certification), ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, Spatial Analysis, and Advanced Terrain Modeling[cite: 1].
